data.content:
<<<DATA describe customers id=643c6049>>>
customers: One row per customer_id (which is per order). customer_unique_id identifies the person.
- customer_id VARCHAR: Key used by orders.customer_id (one per order). [nulls 0%, ~97,769 distinct]
- customer_unique_id VARCHAR: Identifies the same person across orders. [nulls 0%, ~98,358 distinct]
- customer_zip_code_prefix VARCHAR: First five digits of the customer's ZIP code. [nulls 0%, ~15,086 distinct]
- customer_city VARCHAR: Customer city, lower case, without accents. [nulls 0%, ~4,186 distinct]
- customer_state VARCHAR: Two-letter Brazilian state code, e.g. SP, RJ, MG. [nulls 0%, ~26 distinct, values: SP (41,746), RJ (12,852), MG (11,635), RS (5,466), PR (5,045), SC (3,637), BA (3,380), DF (2,140), ES (2,033), GO (2,020), PE (1,652), CE (1,336)]
<<<END DATA id=643c6049>>>
